verdict.rationale: Kimi ships built-in agents that take delegated tasks. Kimi Code Desktop and the CLI let the Agent read code, edit files, run commands and complete development tasks autonomously, and the consumer assistant offers an Agent mode, Agent clusters and agent-built web pages from its main prompt ('做个 Agent 任务'). Community reports note quality issues such as overthinking but do not show the delegation capability failing to exist. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the consumer Agent mode's features and limits (only help-page titles are available), and independent hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks complete reliably.
